senses.gloss: to move from place to place; (of an infant) to crawl. Y. Kidd. IV, 65ᵈ bot.; Y. B. Bath. III, beg. 13ᵈ תינוק המַרְגִּיעַ a (foundling) infant which can leave the place where it was put down.
units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 846:1">Yalk. Ps. 846</cite> <he>וראו אותו מְרַגֵּעַ על וכ׳</he> they saw him crawl on hands and feet with a reed in his mouth &c. (playing with his child); <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 92:1">Midr. Till. to Ps. XCII, 15</cite> ed. Bub. <cite ref="M02192"><he>מַרְגִּיעַ</he></cite> (missing in eds.).
